## Read in scevan results
```{r other_meth_compile_scevan}
read_tsv(
  list.files(
    "output/10_cmp_other_methods/scevan_results",
    pattern = "_scevan_results.tsv",
    full.names = TRUE
  ),
  id = "sample",
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(
    sample = str_remove(sample, "_scevan_results.tsv") %>%
      str_remove(".+/")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    scevan_call = class,
    cell = barcode
  ) %>%
  select(-confidentNormal) %>%
  write_tsv(
    "output/10_cmp_other_methods/scevan_results/compiled_scevan_output.tsv"
  )
```

## Read in numbat results
```{r other_meth_compile_numbat}
numbat_files <- list.files(
  path = "output/10_cmp_other_methods/numbat_results/rdata",
  pattern = "^clone_post_2.tsv$",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE
)

numbat_results <- tibble(sample = character())
for (this_file in numbat_files) {
  numbat_results <-
    read_tsv(
      this_file,
      id = "sample",
      show_col_types = FALSE,
      col_select = c(cell, sample, compartment_opt)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      sample = str_remove(sample, ".+rdata/") %>%
        str_remove("/output/clone_post_2.tsv")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::rename(numbat_call = compartment_opt) %>%
    bind_rows(numbat_results)
}

write_tsv(
  numbat_results,
  "output/10_cmp_other_methods/numbat_results/compiled_numbat_output.tsv"
)

rm(numbat_results, numbat_files)
```

## Read in the scanBit results
```{r other_meth_compile_scanbit}
snv_groups <-
  list.files(
    path = "output/02_snv_calling/snv/human",
    pattern = "meta_data.tsv",
    full.names = TRUE
  ) %>%
  read_tsv(
    show_col_types = FALSE,
    id = "sample",
    col_names = c(
      "cell_group",
      "group",
      "top_lvl_group"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Sample_ID = str_remove(sample, ".+/snvs_") %>%
      str_remove("_10_groups.txt")
  ) %>%
  select(-sample) %>%
  group_by(Sample_ID) %>%
  mutate(n_groups = length(unique(top_lvl_group))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    top_lvl_group = if_else(
      # if there is only one group, we can't assign tumor/normal
      n_groups == 1,
      "Unassigned",
      top_lvl_group
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    sample = Sample_ID,
    cluster_label = cell_group
  )

cell_cluster_key <- get_clusters_from_qs2(unique(snv_groups$sample), "human")

snv_groups <-
  full_join(snv_groups, cell_cluster_key, by = c("sample", "cluster_label")) %>%
  dplyr::rename(scanBit_call = top_lvl_group) %>%
  select(sample, cell, scanBit_call)

write_tsv(
  snv_groups,
  "output/10_cmp_other_methods/scanbit_results/snv_tumor_clust_human.txt"
)
```

## Merge all the human outputs together
```{r other_meth_compile_compile}
call_files <- c(
  "output/10_cmp_other_methods/scevan_results/compiled_scevan_output.tsv",
  "output/10_cmp_other_methods/scatomic_results/compiled_scatomic_output.tsv",
  "output/10_cmp_other_methods/numbat_results/compiled_numbat_output.tsv",
  "output/10_cmp_other_methods/copykat_results/compiled_copykat_output.tsv",
  "output/10_cmp_other_methods/infercna_results/compiled_infercna_output.tsv",
  "output/10_cmp_other_methods/scanbit_results/snv_tumor_clust_human.txt"
)

all_calls <-
  lapply(call_files, function(x) read_tsv(x, show_col_types = FALSE)) %>%
  purrr::reduce(function(x, y) full_join(x, y, by = c("cell", "sample"))) %>%
  mutate(
    scevan_call = str_replace(scevan_call, "normal", "Normal") %>%
      str_replace("tumor", "Tumor") %>%
      str_replace("filtered", "Unassigned") %>%
      replace_na("Unassigned"),
    scatomic_call = str_replace(scatomic_call, "Cancer", "Tumor") %>%
      replace_na("Unassigned"),
    numbat_call = str_replace(numbat_call, "normal", "Normal") %>%
      str_replace("tumor", "Tumor") %>%
      replace_na("Unassigned"),
    copykat_call = str_replace(copykat_call, "aneuploid", "Tumor") %>%
      str_replace("diploid", "Normal") %>%
      str_replace("not.defined", "Unassigned") %>%
      replace_na("Unassigned"),
    infercna_call = str_replace(infercna_call, "nonmalignant", "Normal") %>%
      str_replace("malignant", "Tumor") %>%
      str_replace("unassigned", "Unassigned") %>%
      replace_na("Unassigned")
  )

human_samples <-
  read_tsv("misc/validation_geo_metadata.tsv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::filter(align_ref == "/home/gdrobertslab/lab/GenRef/10x-hg38") %>%
  pull("Sample_ID") %>%
  unique()

human_calls <-
  all_calls %>%
  filter(sample %in% human_samples) %>%
  left_join(
    read_tsv("misc/validation_geo_metadata.tsv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
      select(Sample_ID, sample_group, tumor_type) %>%
      dplyr::rename(sample = Sample_ID) %>%
      distinct() %>%
      mutate(
        sample_group = str_to_title(sample_group) %>%
          str_replace("Validation", "Samples")
      ),
    by = "sample"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(cell)) %>%
  group_by(sample_group) %>%
  order_cells()

write_tsv(
  human_calls,
  "output/10_cmp_other_methods/human_calls.tsv"
)

color_key <- list(
  "Normal" = plot_cols[1],
  "Tumor" = plot_cols[2],
  "Unassigned" = plot_cols[5],
  "top_lvl_group0" = plot_cols[4],
  "top_lvl_group1" = plot_cols[3]
)

alternate_method_call_plot <-
  human_calls %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = ends_with("_call"),
    names_to = "method",
    values_to = "call"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    method = recode(
      method,
      "copykat_call" = "CopyKAT",
      "infercna_call" = "InferCNA",
      "numbat_call" = "Numbat",
      "scevan_call" = "SCEVAN",
      "scatomic_call" = "SCATOMIC",
      "scanBit_call" = "ScanBit"
    ) %>%
      factor(
        levels = c(
          "CopyKAT",
          "InferCNA",
          "Numbat",
          "SCEVAN",
          "SCATOMIC",
          "ScanBit"
        )
      )
  ) %>%
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = cell_order,
      y = method,
      fill = call
    )
  ) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = plot_cols) +
  facet_grid(~sample_group, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  labs(
    x = "Cells",
    y = "Method",
    fill = "Cell type",
    title = "Tumor Cell Identification Discordance Between Methods"
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )

ggsave(
  filename = "output/10_cmp_other_methods/figures/alternate_method_call_plot_human.pdf",
  plot = alternate_method_call_plot,
  width = 10,
  height = 6
)
```

## Lets make pdfs of dimplots for all samples to show all methods

```{r}
human_calls <- read_tsv("output/10_cmp_other_methods/human_calls.tsv")

human_sample_metadata <- read_tsv(
  "misc/validation_geo_metadata.tsv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

human_samples <-
  human_sample_metadata %>%
  dplyr::filter(align_ref == "/home/gdrobertslab/lab/GenRef/10x-hg38") %>%
  pull("Sample_ID") %>%
  unique()

title_key <- list(
  "scevan_call" = "SCEVAN",
  "scatomic_call" = "SCATOMIC",
  "numbat_call" = "Numbat",
  "copykat_call" = "CopyKAT",
  "infercna_call" = "InferCNA",
  "scanBit_call" = "ScanBit",
  "cell_type" = "Cell Type"
)

color_key <- list(
  "Normal" = plot_cols[1],
  "Tumor" = plot_cols[2],
  "Unassigned" = plot_cols[5],
  "top_lvl_group0" = plot_cols[4],
  "top_lvl_group1" = plot_cols[3]
)

for (this_sample in human_samples) {
  message("Processing sample: ", this_sample)

  this_metadata <-
    human_sample_metadata %>%
    dplyr::filter(Sample_ID == this_sample)

  sobj <- qs_read(
    paste0(
      "output/01_process_raw/rdata/individual/",
      this_sample,
      "_human.qs2"
    )
  ) %>%
    AddMetaData(
      human_calls %>%
        dplyr::filter(sample == this_sample) %>%
        column_to_rownames("cell") %>%
        dplyr::select(
          -sample,
          -sample_group,
          -tumor_type,
          -n_cells,
          -pattern_id,
          -cell_order
        )
    )

  image_list <-
    lapply(
      c(
        "scevan_call",
        "scatomic_call",
        "numbat_call",
        "copykat_call",
        "infercna_call",
        "scanBit_call",
        "cell_type"
      ),
      function(x) {
        use_colors <- color_key[names(color_key) %in% sobj@meta.data[[x]]]
        plot_obj <- DimPlot(
          sobj,
          group.by = x,
          #label = TRUE,
          #label.box = TRUE,
          repel = TRUE,
          pt.size = 0.5
        ) +
          labs(title = title_key[[x]]) +
          theme(
            legend.position = "bottom",
            axis.text.x = element_blank(),
            axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
            axis.text.y = element_blank(),
            axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
          )

        if (x != "cell_type") {
          plot_obj <- plot_obj + scale_color_manual(values = use_colors)
        #  plot_obj@layers$geom_label_repel$aes_params$fill <- use_colors[plot_obj@layers$geom_label_repel$data[[x]] %>% as.character()]
        } else {
          plot_obj <-
            LabelClusters(plot_obj, id = "cell_type", box = TRUE) +
            theme(legend.position = "none")
        }

        return(plot_obj)
      }
    )

  plot_layout <- "
    ABC
    DEF
    GGG
    GGG
  "

  ggsave(
    file = paste0(
      "output/10_cmp_other_methods/figures/dimplots/",
      this_sample,
      ".pdf"
    ),
    plot = patchwork::wrap_plots(image_list, design = plot_layout) +
      plot_annotation(
        title = "Tumor Identification Method Comparison",
        subtitle = paste0(
          "Sample: ",
          this_sample,
          ": ",
          this_metadata$description[1]
        )
      ),
    width = 10,
    height = 15
  )
  rm(sobj, image_list)
}
```


## Compare results for known mouse tumors


```{r transgene_groups}
min_transgene_prop <- 0.2

tumor_ids <-
  bind_rows(
    read_tsv(
      "output/07_known_tumors/snv/transgene/transgene_tumor_clust_ltbc.txt",
      show_col_types = FALSE
    ),
    read_tsv(
      "output/07_known_tumors/snv/transgene/transgene_tumor_clust.txt",
      show_col_types = FALSE
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(is_tumor = proportion >= min_transgene_prop) %>%
  mutate(is_tumor = if_else(is_tumor, "Tumor", "Normal")) %>%
  select(Sample_ID, cell_group, is_tumor) %>%
  dplyr::rename(cluster_label = cell_group, sample = Sample_ID)

sample_cluster_table <-
  lapply(
    unique(tumor_ids$sample),
    function(x) {
      qs_read(paste0(
        "output/01_process_raw/rdata/individual/",
        x,
        "_mouse.qs2"
      )) %>%
        .[[]] %>%
        select(cell_barcode, cluster_label, individ_clusters, Sample_ID)
    }
  ) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  mutate(cluster_label = paste0(cluster_label, "_c", individ_clusters)) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    cell = cell_barcode,
    sample = Sample_ID
  ) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  left_join(tumor_ids) %>%
  mutate(actual_state = if_else(is.na(is_tumor), "Unassigned", is_tumor)) %>%
  left_join(
    read_tsv("output/07_known_tumors/snv/transgene/snv_tumor_clust.txt") %>%
      dplyr::rename(
        cluster_label = cell_group,
        sample = Sample_ID,
        snv_call = top_lvl_group
      ) %>%
      dplyr::select(-group, -n_groups)
  ) %>%
  select(sample, cell, snv_call, actual_state) %>%
  mutate(
    snv_call = if_else(is.na(snv_call), "Unassigned", snv_call) %>%
      # The top_lvl_group0 seems to always be tumor. I assume that when the
      # dendrogram is made, the most distant cluster from the root is labeled
      # as top_lvl_group0.
      str_replace("top_lvl_group0", "Tumor") %>%
      str_replace("top_lvl_group1", "Normal")
  )


mouse_samples <-
  tumor_ids$sample %>%
  unique()

mouse_calls <-
  all_calls %>%
  filter(sample %in% mouse_samples) %>%
  left_join(sample_cluster_table, by = c("sample", "cell")) %>%
  order_cells(
    call_cols = c(
      "scevan_call",
      "copykat_call",
      "infercna_call"
    )
  )

alternate_method_call_plot <-
  mouse_calls %>%
  select(-scatomic_call, -numbat_call) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(ends_with("_call"), "actual_state"),
    names_to = "method",
    values_to = "call"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    method = recode(
      method,
      "scevan_call" = "SCEVAN",
      "copykat_call" = "CopyKAT",
      "infercna_call" = "InferCNA",
      "snv_call" = "scanBit",
      "actual_state" = "Actual State"
    ) %>%
      factor(
        levels = c("SCEVAN", "CopyKAT", "InferCNA", "scanBit", "Actual State")
      )
  ) %>%
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = cell_order,
      y = method,
      fill = call
    )
  ) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = plot_cols) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank())

ggsave(
  filename = "output/10_cmp_other_methods/figures/alternate_method_call_plot_known_tumors.pdf",
  plot = alternate_method_call_plot,
  width = 10,
  height = 6
)
```
